name: Barnstaple Foodbank
short_description: Trussell Trust foodbank at Barnstaple Community Church
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network. Provides emergency food parcels and support to local residents in crisis. Open Tuesdays and Fridays.

name: Barnstaple Community Garden
short_description: Community garden at Rock Park with riverside plots
months: this garden has 25 plots and a wildlife area. Regular work parties every Sunday.

name: Barnstaple Community Fridge
short_description: Community fridge at Pannier Market reducing food waste
description: Located at the historic Pannier Market
months: this fridge allows residents to share surplus food. Open during market hours.
